review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native Thai review (preferably a Chiang Mai speaker; the text is spoken-standard Central Thai). Speakers: sam=Sam (man; ผม; narrates without particles), daeng=Auntie Daeng (woman; calls herself ป้า; ค่ะ / คะ). For the reviewer - Sam looks back on his second month in plain first-person narration (ผม, no particles) with one short quotation from Auntie; ยัง + verb for "still"; เคย + verb for "have (never) done"; ความ in ความหมาย ("meaning"); the joke is the near-sound ไก่ / ไข่ (chicken / egg) - check that a learner could really mix them up; the unit does not use กว่า yet (comparatives start in th-a1-2-13).

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed
